ideas.title: Review of Equality, Diversity and Inclusion officer roles
alternative_routes: Workforce / establishment review by S151 + HR director
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet directs S151/HR to scope EDI roles + report back; no jobs cut without process
opposition_counter: This is a culture-war attack on equalities duties under the Equality Act 2010.
Reform will face legal challenge from staff and equality bodies.
pre_empt_lines: The council's statutory equalities duties under the Equality Act 2010 are unchanged.
The review is into role design and headcount efficiency, not the council's compliance with the public sector equality duty.

ideas.title: Cut Special Responsibility Allowances (SRAs) and freeze Members' basic allowance
alternative_routes: Independent Remuneration Panel referral with a Reform-direction submission
ideas.first_concrete_action: Refer Members' Allowances Scheme to the Independent Remuneration Panel with a Reform direction to cut SRAs by 25-50%
opposition_counter: This will deter working-class candidates from public office.
The IRP is independent — Reform are politicising it.
pre_empt_lines: The cuts apply to elected members' Special Responsibility Allowances, not the basic allowance, preserving access for working-class candidates.
The IRP remains independent — this is a direction the council is entitled to make under the Local Authorities (Members' Allowances) Regulations.
ideas.precedent: Lancashire CC May 2025 — Reform froze SRAs and committed to an IRP review; widely reported locally as a credibility signal.

ideas.title: Multi-year council tax freeze pledge tied to verifiable savings
alternative_routes: Cabinet pledge with annual confirmation at MTFS
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet drafts pledge tied to procurement-savings + officer-overhead targets; motion to confirm at next Full Council
opposition_counter: This will force frontline service cuts.
Reform are making a populist promise without a deliverable plan.
pre_empt_lines: The freeze is conditional on procurement savings, officer-overhead reduction, and a published delivery plan — not magical accounting.

ideas.title: National anthem before every Full Council meeting
alternative_routes: Cabinet decision (faster, no opposition vote — recommended if avoiding opposition spectacle)
Civic Mayor's standing direction at the start of mayoralty
ideas.first_concrete_action: Civic Mayor publishes a chamber-procedure note on day-1, motion to formalise at next Full Council
opposition_counter: This is performative culture-war politics that does nothing for residents.
Reform are wasting council time on flag-waving while bins go uncollected.
pre_empt_lines: This council notes that residents and serving forces personnel deserve to see public institutions take national symbols seriously.
This is a no-cost change consistent with the council's existing Armed Forces Covenant obligations.
ideas.precedent: Lancashire County Council, May 2025 (proceeded by Civic Mayor's direction; widely covered locally and nationally as a Reform signature move)

ideas.title: Public publication of supplier concentration + HHI per portfolio
ideas.first_concrete_action: Head of Procurement publishes top-25 suppliers + HHI per service area + tendering history within 60 days

facts: Smallest of the 12 new councils — £58M total procurement-paid. KEELE UNIVERSITY £3.2M / 30 txns (research partnership), HARWORTH GROUP £2.9M in a SINGLE transaction (property regeneration), CAPITAL & CENTRIC (DISTANT WORLD) LTD £2.8M / 13 txns (developer).
CIPFA resilience proxy: **Distressed** despite small budget — composite quartile 3.3.
Supplier-linked donor matches total £826,496 across Labour + Conservative + Liberal Democrats — anomalously high for a district council. This is matched supplier-to-donor, not council donations.
Newcastle-under-Lyme is in Staffordshire — Local Government Reorganisation is live for Staffordshire CC. The district may be folded into a new unitary authority.

ideas.evidence_summary: Newcastle-under-Lyme has supplier concentration HHI of 221 in procurement (>0.25 = red flag). The largest single supplier is ${top_supplier} at £${top_supplier_spend_m}m / 5.5% of procurement.

ideas.title: Fly the Union Jack permanently from the council building
alternative_routes: Estates / facilities management policy update (no political vote needed)
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet decision to amend the council's flag-flying protocol; formal flag-flying protocol published within 14 days
opposition_counter: Refusal to fly the Pride flag will alienate LGBT residents.
pre_empt_lines: This council notes that the Union Jack is the flag of all residents regardless of background, and is not in conflict with civic values of inclusion.
The council's existing equalities duties are unaffected.

ideas.title: Suspend international council trips / town twinning travel
ideas.first_concrete_action: Standing instruction; ongoing twinning agreements paused with formal notification

ideas.title: Public register of all council consultancy spend, with daily-rate caps
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet directs Head of Procurement to compile + publish; daily-rate cap (e.g. £750/day) effective 30 days

ideas.title: Veterans' discount on council services (where lawfully possible)
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet commissions a legal review of which services can lawfully offer a veterans' concession + costing

ideas.title: Visible re-commitment to the Armed Forces Covenant
alternative_routes: Cabinet renewal of existing covenant + public ceremony
ideas.first_concrete_action: Restate covenant publicly + appoint dedicated Armed Forces Champion (cabinet member)

ideas.title: Cap conference attendance at £X per councillor per year + publish all attendance
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet sets cap; auto-publication via the existing transparency portal

ideas.title: Cabinet member meal + hospitality expense cap with monthly publication
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet decision to cap + standing publication direction

ideas.title: Cap on communications / press office headcount + social-media-team review
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet directs HR to publish current establishment + benchmarks vs 5 peer councils

ideas.title: Zero-based budget pilot in one portfolio
ideas.first_concrete_action: S151 + Cabinet Member for Resources select a portfolio for ZBB pilot; report at next MTFS

ideas.title: Reinstate prayers / minute's silence before Full Council
ideas.first_concrete_action: Mayor's chaplain (or non-denominational alternative) takes 60 seconds at the start of each meeting

ideas.title: Council communications use "Christmas" not "winter festival" / "festive season" wording
ideas.first_concrete_action: Comms style-guide update — no governance overhead

ideas.title: Fly the St George flag on St George's Day (or county flag where applicable)
ideas.first_concrete_action: Estates standing instruction, no governance overhead

ideas.title: Livestream every council meeting permanently
ideas.first_concrete_action: Standing instruction to Democratic Services; cost-bench against 3 peer councils; pilot from next Full Council

ideas.title: Reverse library opening-hours cuts (where reduced under previous administration)
ideas.first_concrete_action: Publish hours-cuts timeline since 2020 + cost of restoration; Cabinet decision with full costing within 60 days

ideas.title: Reopen public toilets closed under previous administration
alternative_routes: Working with parish councils where applicable
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet identifies closed sites + costing for reopening within 30 days

ideas.title: Visible fly-tipping enforcement campaign with prosecutions published
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet directs publication of monthly prosecutions + fines + locations; deploy mobile CCTV at known hotspots

ideas.title: Publish FOI response-time SLA with monthly performance dashboard
ideas.first_concrete_action: Monitoring Officer publishes 6-month historical performance + SLA target + dashboard from next quarter

ideas.title: Real-time members' gifts and hospitality register
ideas.first_concrete_action: Standards Committee chair sets monthly publication + auto-feed to the council website

ideas.title: Restore / install a King's portrait in the council chamber
ideas.first_concrete_action: Civic Mayor commissions a print of the official portrait (free from the Royal Household)

ideas.title: Civic recognition of the county / town flag (where exists)
ideas.first_concrete_action: Estates / facilities to fly the county flag on county days alongside the Union Jack

ideas.title: Publish a rationale paragraph for every cabinet decision
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet member rota writes a 100-word rationale per decision; published with the agenda

ideas.title: Public procurement-savings target (3-5% on third-party spend)
ideas.first_concrete_action: Cabinet adopts a published savings target with quarterly reporting
ideas.evidence_summary: Newcastle-under-Lyme's third-party procurement spend is £58.9m per annum. A 3% savings target is £1.8m / 5% is £2.9m.
